summary: Verified Emergent-side FastAPI health stub + external Railway Node backend + frontend integration. Local stub GET /health -> {ok:true} and GET /api/ -> runtime:'stub' (via new pytest cases). Railway backend GET /api/ -> runtime:'node', /api/locations returns {mathura, rewari}, story flows work, and Supabase media library is now fully configured. Added a real JPEG upload → download → delete roundtrip test that hits Supabase via Railway — all pass (201/200/204). No residual references to Emergent-internal /api in frontend beyond REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend flows validated via Playwright at localhost:3000: /stories shows seeded story card (data-testid=story-card-diwali-in-the-old-sabha-courtyard) with valid wa.me share href, /stories/:slug renders data-testid=story-title + story-share-whatsapp button, main nav has Journal link, language toggle + location switcher present, /admin token sign-in with 'mahawar-admin-dev-token' works, data-testid=admin-goto-stories navigates to /admin/stories which lists seed story with Media library shortcut visible. Frontend network trace confirms API calls go to https://mahawar-sabha-webapp-production.up.railway.app.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py stub is minimal and appropriate; no business logic leaked to Emergent side.
Media status endpoint correctly public; upload/delete correctly enforce adminOnly + storage-configured.
seed_data_creation: Seed story diwali-in-the-old-sabha-courtyard already present on Railway. Test-created stories/assets cleaned up via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set to the Railway URL. Frontend served by Emergent at localhost:3000 (proxied via ingress). Playwright network listener confirms XHRs hit railway.app hostname. Media is now configured (Supabase bucket 'mahawar-sabha'); previous 503 STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED assertions were updated to real upload/download/delete roundtrip.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found this iteration.
